read_model: ManualAiBridgeReadService displays manual package/proposal lifecycle. AiDraftCreationService.create delegates to LessonRevisionWorkflow.createDraft.
invariants: Invalid provenance fails closed for draft creation

epistemic.empty: No proposal: prepare manual packet; no automatic generation indicator.
epistemic.stale: Source revision changed: retain original provenance and require review of stale proposal.
epistemic.unavailable: Missing source digest: cannot accept; retain proposal for evidence request.
epistemic.error: Malformed proposal quarantined as PROVENANCE_INVALID; no canonical write.
